raw_comment:
1. I notice that there is a map of the US with several different shades of warm colors. The colors are all seen in different parts of the US, with some more drastic than others. I see more light colors than darker colors. I notice that the mid portion of the United States, especially Oklahoma and Texas have the largest amount of more extreme droughts. 
2. I wonder the cause of an exceptional drought, which seems to be the most extreme kind of drought across the US. I also wonder how much this has affected lots of agriculture in the US since it has become such a drastic issue. I wonder why there are no droughts in Alaska? I also wonder how certain states are coping with the extreme droughts throughout the US? 
3. I think that in this graph, it is displaying the severity of droughts throughout the US in the past couple weeks. 
4. This relates to me and my community by acknowledging such a big issue. For a moment, there was absolutely no rain fall near me. There were signs throughout the highways to not start any fires because of the high risk of forest fires. From the no rain fall, there has been lots of droughts caused by this which affects lots of agriculture throughout the US, which ultimately affects us.  
5. Caution: Severe droughts in US!
